excerpts.content:
In the context of single tx:
1. It can do pure ETH transfer (e.g. if you target yourself ETH is not destroyed).
2. Only the nonce and code is cleared. Then "empty" account clear rule kicks in: if balance is 0 the account will be deleted otherwise it will stay.
